content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: First Class Postgraduate Degree (including integrated PG degrees) in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, or other relevant disciplines, with three years of relevant research experience; OR Ph.D. in a relevant discipline, as per applicable guidelines Experience: Three years of relevant research experience (with the postgraduate degree route) Age limit: As per applicable ICMR/AIIMS guidelines; age calculated as on the last date of application Age relaxation: Age relaxation, if applicable, as per ICMR/AIIMS rules Other conditions: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Desirable: Knowledge and practical experience in Epidemiology, Biostatistics and Public Health Research Statistical analysis using SPSS, STATA, R, SAS or equivalent statistical packages Experience in epidemiological study designs including cross-sectional, case-control and cohort studies Research project coordination, monitoring, implementation and overall project management; developing protocols, manuscripts, reports and presentations Managing research databases, data quality assurance and coordination with multidisciplinary research teams Prior experience in clinical or population-based research is an added advantage

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments as per applicable ICMR guidelines; salary and other benefits governed by applicable ICMR/AIIMS guidelines. Purely temporary and contractual for the duration of the project or until the project continues, whichever is earlier
